summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Churvox Phase 1 Batch 1 rebranding. All 19 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI testing verified Churvox branding, dark-slate theme, navigation, and multi-trade functionality.

Client CRUD operations working
Job creation with multi-trade types (plumbing, electrical, cleaning, handyman, painting) working
Job workflow (create -> start -> complete) working
Quote creation and send workflow working
Invoice creation with GST calculation (15% default) working
Invoice workflow (create -> send -> mark paid) working
User settings: GST rate update working
User settings: Trade type update working
Plan update (solo, solo_plus) working
Team/Pro plans correctly return 'coming soon' error
Login page: Churvox logo visible, dark-slate theme, electric blue accents

Login page: No old branding (Grassly/Mowtix/lawn-only) found
Dashboard: Navigation shows Dashboard, Jobs, Calendar, Clients, More

Dashboard: Quick Actions (New Job, New Quote, New Client, New Invoice) visible

Mobile More dropdown: Contains Quotes, Invoices, Plans, Settings

Logo appears in header, login page, signup page - properly sized
